strategy.summary: Reproduce sympy PR #27287 bug: Float(np.float32(inf)) raises OverflowError from _convert_numpy_types calling as_integer_ratio on infinite numpy float; the fix returns Float('inf')/Float('-inf') for infinite inputs. Run the added test_issue_27284 in sympy/core/tests/test_sympify.py on buggy commit fea3c41c1c7a (fails) and on the fixed revision (passes).

pinned_because: numpy==2.1.3 is an explicit documented constraint from the issue #27284 report environment (numerically relevant); numpy must be installed or the test is skipped

sympy==1.13.3 is an explicit documented constraint from the report; the repository checkout at the buggy commit is used for the code under test, so the installed sympy must be the source tree rather than a PyPI release
python_version 3.10.15 is the reported interpreter version

strategy.reproducing_test: def test_issue_27284(): if not numpy: skip('numpy not installed.'); assert Float(numpy.float32(float('inf'))) == S.Infinity; assert Float(numpy.float32(float('-inf'))) == S.NegativeInfinity
strategy.success_criterion: On buggy revision fea3c41c1c7a the test errors/fails with OverflowError: cannot convert Infinity to integer ratio raised from _convert_numpy_types (test is not passing). On the fixed revision (PR #27287 applied, with isposinf/isneginf checks before as_integer_ratio) the test passes with no exception. The transition fail-to-pass is the whole criterion.

input_output_examples.buggy_output: OverflowError: cannot convert Infinity to integer ratio
OverflowError: cannot convert Infinity to integer ratio

risks: Test is skipped if numpy is not importable in the test environment; confirm numpy 2.1.3 is installed so the skip does not masquerade as a pass.
The test module defines `numpy` via try-import at top of test_sympify.py; verify the import succeeds, otherwise both revisions skip and the transition is invisible.

Installing with pip install sympy from PyPI would test the wrong code; the source checkout at the buggy and fixed commits must be installed (pip install -e .) so the import resolves to the repository.
Environment is reported only for Python 3.10.15 / numpy 2.1.3 / sympy 1.13.3; behaviour on other numpy versions (e.g. numpy 1.x where float32 handling differs) is not established by the evidence.
No platform or sanitizer dependence is stated; the defect is expected to be platform-independent, but this is inferred from the traceback rather than shown.
The fixed-branch finite-value path (prec = np.finfo(a).nmant + 1 with mlib.from_rational) is not exercised by this test; no precision value should be assumed from the evidence.

oracle.reference_source: PR #27287 test_issue_27284 assertions comparing to S.Infinity and S.NegativeInfinity
oracle.why: Infinity is mapped to a symbolic singleton, so equality comparison is exact.

strategy.fails_on_buggy: Buggy code reaches a.as_integer_ratio() on the infinite np.float32, which raises OverflowError, so the test errors before any assertion is evaluated.
strategy.passes_on_fixed: Fixed code checks np.isposinf/np.isneginf first and returns S.Infinity / S.NegativeInfinity equivalents, so both assertions evaluate True.
